delegationWaitReleasedByTask: This wait is released when its delegated task is done — it can't be released by hand.
bindNotATask: Only a Task can be made asynchronous.
spawnedNotStored: This wait was spawned by its task — edit the task's template instead.
agentWaiting: An agent is waiting on you
agentWaitNote: What the agent is waiting on
agentAnswerHint: Needed before the wait can be released
drawnFromTemplate: Its task spawned this wait: the title, Time Scope, Check every and tags come from the task's Expectation template and are edited there (Shift+W on the task).
